title: Career Roadmap — Battery Technician
summary: A Battery Technician inspects, tests, maintains, diagnoses, and repairs battery systems used in electric vehicles (EVs). The role involves battery packs, battery management systems (BMS), electrical connections, charging systems, thermal management, and battery safety.

blocks.text: A Battery Technician inspects, tests, maintains, diagnoses, and repairs battery systems used in electric vehicles (EVs). The role involves battery packs, battery management systems (BMS), electrical connections, charging systems, thermal management, and battery safety.
For a B.Voc graduate specializing in Electric Vehicle Technology, this is a practical, skill-oriented career pathway.
The strongest employability combination is EV battery fundamentals + electrical troubleshooting + BMS diagnostics + high-voltage safety + battery testing + workshop experience.

blocks.label: Safety requirement
blocks.text: High-voltage EV batteries can cause fatal electric shock, severe burns, and fire. Live pack measurements, battery disassembly, isolation testing, and internal repairs must only be performed with the appropriate training, authorization, equipment, and manufacturer-approved procedures. Do not practice on live high-voltage packs as a beginner.

sections.heading: Year 4 — Advanced Diagnostics and Industry Readiness

Target Profile by Graduation

By graduation, the student should be able to explain EV battery architecture, interpret basic BMS data, identify common battery-system symptoms, use diagnostic tools in a supervised environment, follow approved safety procedures, and document a troubleshooting case clearly.

blocks.label: Best overall positioning
blocks.text: B.Voc Electric Vehicle Technology → Battery Technician is a practical vocational pathway into the EV industry. The strongest early-career combination is battery fundamentals + BMS diagnostics + electrical troubleshooting + high-voltage safety + supervised workshop experience. Long-term growth can lead toward battery diagnostics, testing, quality, service management, or battery analytics.
